caption: The video captures a low-angle view of a car tire on coarse asphalt, with three translucent gel toys bearing googly eyes lined along the tread: blue left, green middle, red right. The silver rim fills the upper frame, its barrel showing a yellowish-green reflection. At the start the green and red toys are already partly beneath the rubber, beginning to be pressed. As the clip continues the tread presses them into thin, flattened discs, their googly eyes staying perched on the squished tops. The blue toy remains mostly round until the load reaches it. The wheel rotates and the contact line shifts, so the crushing pressure travels leftward across the row. Near the end the tread reaches the blue toy, pressing its upper side into a flattened disc. The framing drifts as the tire moves toward the image center and the bright sill leaves the top-left.
relations: As the tire rotates, the contact line shifts leftward across the row of toys.
Green and red toys under the rubber flatten into discs, with googly eyes staying perched on top.
The blue toy remains mostly round until the load reaches it, then its upper side flattens.
The tire moving toward the image center causes the framing to drift.
